name: multi-file-change
description: Rename a helper function and every call site across three source files.
prompt: Rename the helper function `format_price` to `format_amount` across the codebase: update the definition in src/lib.py and every call site in src/app.py and src/report.py. Then make `python3 tests/test_rename.py` print ok. The old name `format_price` must no longer appear anywhere in src/ or tests/.
